scope: Balance conversation titles and nearby controls
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--long-title-compact-dark.pn.task: Read long conversation titles while reaching their current actions.
conversation--long-title-compact-dark.pn.observations: The complete long title wraps onto two readable lines without hiding text. Planned work, status, Details and overflow stay aligned and separate from the title. At 760 × 550 the title controls fit without overlap and the unsent message stays visible. Light/dark text contrast and tab selection are clear.
